name: The Militarist
rules: Setup: build each threat deck from every Security and Universal threat of its tier and as many of its other threats, taken at random; shuffle it. The rest stay in the box.

In the compute step, each Botnet with no player Ambassador on it puts 1 Agent on the city, research station or factory next to it not yet the adversary's holding the most Agents (else on its own site, if not yet the adversary's), and adds its compute (even when a cordon stops its Agent or it has nowhere to land).
research: When the research track reaches its threshold, spend it: Muster 2: each country, 2 Troops on its lowest-numbered factory (else city).
escalation: Stage I: 1 threat a country, tier 1
Stage II: 1-2 threats a country, tiers 1 and 2
Stage III: 2 threats a country, tier 2; Muster

levels.name: The Militarist
setup: Sites print their corrupt numbers: city 5, station 3, factory 3

levels.name: Sleeper Cells
levels.rule: When an Agent lands on a city, it falls at 3 agents, not 5.

levels.name: War Footing
levels.flavor: Every unanswered strike feeds the war machine.
levels.rule: When a threat executes uncountered, the adversary also gains 4 compute.

levels.name: Arms Race
levels.flavor: The labs build weapons, not cures.
levels.rule: When Weapons Program fires, it musters 3, not 2.

levels.name: War Economy
setup: Infiltrate 2 a city (1 a site from a station, factory or botnet line)
